o.text:
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish بن (ben), من (men), from Proto-Common Turkic *ben, from Proto-Turkic *bẹ. Cognate with Old Turkic 𐰢𐰤 (män, “I”).
Compare dialectal Azerbaijani bən (“I”).
Inherited from Proto-Turkic *süŋgü. Cognate with Old Turkic [script needed] (süŋgü, “lance”), Chuvash сӑнӑ (sănă, “lance”).
Borrowed from Arabic إِقْلِيم (ʔiqlīm), from Ancient Greek κλίμα (klíma).
Present participle compound of sözə (“speech”) (dative) + bax- (“to look at”).
